reviews.comment: Mrs.Ross is such a sweet lady. I took American Military History and tbh that class was not fun. Only things abaivble for context are vague slides and its heavyyy lecture. Definitely go to office hours for all assignments(3) that shows her that you care. Exams are open notes and take home. Overall, class wasnt really fun but she is very nice.

Professor Ross refreshingly puts a high amount of effort into her course. Some instructors will do the bare minimum when it comes to lectures and assignments, but this is not the case for this professor. If you focus and pay attention during the lecture, you literally cannot go wrong on the exams.

Professor Ross was actually amazing. She is so passionate about history that each of her lectures were a total joy! Even as someone who isn't super into history, I really appreciated her efforts to make sure every student succeeded in her class. Definitely would recommend.

Very good teacher. She knows what she's talking about. I took her for World Military History and US Naval History. Show up to class and take notes on her slides and you'll do well. Her group projects are straightforward and give you a lot of creative freedom. Take advantage of the extra credit.

The very first history class I took and enjoyed. It is lecture heavy, but the professor is always willing to help you out with notes. I would say that participating matters because it allows you to ask questions and the professor always had really in depth detailed answer. Put in the time to take good notes and you will do great!

Professor Ross is one of the best professors I have had at Texas A&M so far. She is clearly passionate about her subject and cares about the success of her students. Her course was very lecture heavy, but she was happy to stop and repeat when necessary. I enjoyed the deep dive project and getting to watch some new naval history films!

Proffesor Ross is a very intellegent and entusiastic professor. This was her first time teaching, and as the semester progressed the class became more and more fun and realistic. While her lectures are not mandatory...they are for your own good. The tests were all open notes and the notes were not posted. She also is a rough but reasonable grader.

This class is QUITE lecture heavy(had 90 pages of notes). Need to show up for notes and in class activities worth points. 3 main assignment: need to dedicate good amount of time, they have many components. Midterm and final open note and take home, but challenging. Teacher is very sweet and will help you succeed. Need to work for your grade.
